receipt_semantics: Each printed original contract is emitted only after two actual complete workload runs match its blocks/logs/history exactly; two-turn workloads each produce two actual IChatClient streams. This is verified contract data, not an unvalidated oracle or timed log collector.
harness_reuse: Original immutable harness DLL/PDB frozen into after-2 and after-3 after checking runtime/deps and complete owner-only closure; uncompared rebuilt-harness after snapshot retained.
identity_normalization: Only actual GUID block IDs are symbolically mapped per operation, consistently in blocks and their logs; identity relationships/distinctness/order remain observable. Other strings/logs are not masked.
actual_boundary: Real public UIAgent SendMessageAsync fully consumed; actual IChatClient stream and unchanged BlockMappingPipeline; generated logs, finalized blocks and next-turn request history. Recorded-provider update shapes cloned through real stream producer.
permanent_boundary: Components.AI managed/service unit tests and provider-recording replay tests; no renderer/JS/DI/browser-owned seam or browser success claim.
